results.snippet: Nigeria has spent over $2.5 billion on railway modernisation in the last 10 years, largely from Chinese EXIM Bank loans and Federal Government counterpart funding. The Lagos-Ibadan Standard Gauge (157km) cost $1.6 billion. The Abuja-Kaduna Standard Gauge (187km) cost $876 million.
